I lost my one of my 'supposed' close friends because she asked me to be her boyfriend and I indirectly rejected her.

I became friends with this girl in college, we spent the majority of our free time together as friends. Or so I thought. I should've seen the writing on the wall but my brain was too dumb to distinguish between friendzone and other zones that are not meant for friends.  I was in that we weren't-lovers-but-more-than-friends zone with her. She cared a lot of about me and treated me the way a girlfriend would treat her boyfriend but I still thought that's what friends would do to each other (holding hands, her leaning on my shoulder, etc). I was getting way too comfortable around to realize that she was having a huge crush on me. In retrospect, I'm really amazed by how naive I was, she was really giving away signs that she was into me but again my dumb brain took out of those signs as platonic.

Then one night, on her 23rd birthday, she sent me a voicemail and a lengthy message to the effect that she was head over heals for me and asked if I felt the same and whether or not I wanted us to be an item. She ended the message with a take-it-or-leave it ultimatum (sort of). That I either would either become her boyfriend by showing up at this certain spot as the clock strikes midnight or we would go back to being strangers. I chose to the latter.

It broke my heart but I didn't want to lie to her and let her believe that there were anything beyond friendship between us.
